source: User-run live round, eval/clean-taste-checklist.html. Extracted verbatim from the checklist's saved state by Fable. The 'expected' fields are the user's own written targets and are Clean mode's calibration set — the rolling held-out protocol from review/LEDGER.md applies.
bar: fidelity plus polish: exactly what was said, cleanly — nothing the user would fix by hand

fix_always.note: keep the user's verb — never substitute 'get back to me'
